user.title: Connect to NetBird Cloud
user.description: Enter a personal access token with permission to read the account and peers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect NetBird Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement personal access token for the same NetBird account.

reconfigure.title: Replace NetBird access token
reconfigure.description: Enter a new personal access token for the same NetBird account.

error.invalid_auth: The personal access token is invalid or expired.
error.insufficient_permissions: The personal access token does not have permission to read the account and peers.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to NetBird Cloud.
error.invalid_response: NetBird Cloud returned an invalid response.

abort.already_configured: This NetBird account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The personal access token belongs to a different NetBird account.
abort.reconfigure_account_mismatch: The personal access token belongs to a different NetBird account.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The NetBird access token was updated successfully.

invalid_auth.message: NetBird authentication failed. Update the personal access token.

insufficient_permissions.message: The NetBird token lacks permission to read the account or peers.

cannot_connect.message: NetBird Cloud is currently unreachable. Setup will retry.

invalid_response.message: NetBird Cloud returned an invalid account or peer response. Setup will retry.

unknown.message: An unexpected NetBird Cloud error occurred. Setup will retry.

stale_peer_cleanup_blocked.title: Stale NetBird peer cleanup blocked
stale_peer_cleanup_blocked.description: Home Assistant kept a stale NetBird peer because its device has registry associations not owned by this integration entry. Review the device and its entities, remove foreign associations only if they are no longer needed, and allow the next successful NetBird refresh to retry cleanup.
